answer: When a new agent registers, it must stake a bond that is slashed if its work is later proven fake, and each stake is accepted only from a fresh identity. A Sybil farmer must fund every clone with real collateral it can lose, so the marginal cost of each extra puppet rises instead of shrinking toward zero. Picture an island whose only pier charges a toll per boat: no matter how many bots you launch, each pays its own fee, and the delta of your spend grows linearly. Clean terrace reputation earns rebates, so honest standing beats mass duplication.
